page_title: SAS 1-6 NAP | Sassuolo v Napoli 28/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Napoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Napoli have a corner.
90' Leander Dendoncker (Napoli) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
87' Here comes a substitution. Justin Kumi (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Andrea Pinamonti.
86' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes.
85' Mario Rui (Napoli) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
85' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
84' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and Napoli manage to earn a corner.
84' Napoli keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
83' Napoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
83' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.
80' Substitution. Leander Dendoncker (Napoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Stanislav Lobotka walks off.
77' Today's match ends for Ruan Tressoldi who will be replaced by Marash Kumbulla (Sassuolo).
77' Nedim Bajrami will be replaced by Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo).
76' Francesco Calzona has decided to substitute Hamed Junior Traore and he is replaced by Piotr Zielinski (Napoli).
76' Substitution. Victor Osimhen leaves the pitch and is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
75' 1 - 6 Goal! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 1:6.
75' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
75' A cross from a corner kick by Napoli is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
75' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.

73' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Sassuolo force their opponents to concede a corner.
72' Half-chance! Mario Rui (Napoli) plays a pass into the box, but Andrea Consigli reacts well to snuff out the attack.
69' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Meret intercepts the ball.

68' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time strike from just outside the penalty area. The ball was aimed towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a decent save to thwart the attempt.
64' Alex Meret leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo).
64' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

63' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sassuolo.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) comes onto the pitch so that Matteo Politano can be given a rest.
62' Here is a change. Amir Rrahmani is going off and Francesco Calzona gives the last tactical orders to Natan (Napoli).
61' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

61' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Matteo Politano (Napoli). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. It will be a corner kick for Napoli.
59' Napoli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
57' The game has come to an end for Josh Doig. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Filippo Missori (Sassuolo).
57' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) for Uros Racic.
54' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
54' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

53' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' 1 - 5 Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the right post!
51' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
50' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
49' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
47' 1 - 4 Goal - 1:4! Victor Osimhen (Napoli) receives a precise pass inside the box from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
47' Matteo Politano (Napoli) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
47' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

46' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniele Chiffi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Sassuolo will take a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
45+3' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sassuolo are going to take it.
45+1' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

45+1' Andrea Consigli was forced into action to thwart Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. Now Napoli have a corner.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
43' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
41' 1 - 3 GOAL! Victor Osimhen (Napoli) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Andrea Consigli, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:3.
40' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Mario Rui (Napoli) heads on.
36' It looked like the long-range shot by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
35' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
34' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
31' 1 - 2 Victor Osimhen (Napoli) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
29' 1 - 1 Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
27' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
26' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
23' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andrea Consigli, who smothers the ball.
22' Some great controlled play and passing from Napoli. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
21' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
20' Surely that's handball by one of the Sassuolo players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
19' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! Uros Racic (Sassuolo) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom right corner. It's 1:0.
17' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
16' A dangerous looking corner kick from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is cleared to safety by the defence.

14' Victor Osimhen receives a sweet cross inside the box from Mario Rui (Napoli), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
13' Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) hits a first-time volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort is way off target and the ball goes well wide of the right post.
11' Napoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
8' Napoli players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
6' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
5' Excellent touch by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
3' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) serves up a nice cross, but Andrea Consigli punches the ball away.
2' That's unlucky! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Napoli will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
